title: Page 7
content_zh:
被急急叫来的大夫赶紧进到客房，开始替草儿检查处理伤势，戚无秋也在这时被带往一旁坐着休息，但他始终不肯离开客房，坚持寸步不离地陪在草儿身旁。
戚无雍一看到他鲜血淋漓的双手，惊诧地说：「三哥，你的手上都是伤，赶紧处理处理吧。」
「我没事，不过只是小伤……」他现在根本没有任何心思管自己，他只要草儿能够顺利脱险。
戚无雍关心地嚷道：「就算只是小伤也得要处理呀！快，谁赶紧去拿一盆干净的水还有伤药来，把三哥手上的伤给处理一下……」
戚无秋现在一颗心全放在昏迷不醒的草儿身上，任由仆人替他的双手清洗、上药、包扎，对于手伤的痛早已没有任何感觉。
在大夫将草儿身上的伤都处理完毕之后，戚无秋又冲到床边，担心地询问：「大夫，她的情况怎么样？」
「她的左手臂因为强力撞击而骨折，脑后则是因为撞到尖石而划伤了，幸好抢救得早，要是再耽搁一段时间，情况就很危急了。」
「所以你的意思是，她会活得好好的？」
大夫点点头。「她的手臂需要较久的时间复原，得要小心照顾，至于脑后的伤，不是非常严重，幸好没有伤到要害，应该一阵子就能苏醒过来，只要能醒过来，就不会有什么大碍。」
听完大夫的回答，戚无秋始终害怕高悬的心终于可以放下来了，他大大地松了口气，幸好一切都还来得及，草儿的命总算被他给捡回来了，他不必再害怕有可能会永远失去她了。
等她一醒，他保证再也不让她离开了……
她浑浑噩噩地陷在黑暗中挣扎，头不断地阵阵抽痛，熟悉的景象不停地出现在她脑海中，逼迫她不得不去面对。
她看到了……一间眼熟的屋子，还有一个让她感到亲切的男子，那个男子好像是……是她的哥哥。
「若柳，你要出门？」
「是呀，我要去城南的观音庙上香，祈求一切平安顺利。」她柔声应道。
哥哥最近经商不是很顺利，所以她想去帮哥哥祈求好运。另外，她还希望祈求自己绣的一些手帕、香囊，寄放在店家贩卖能赚些小钱，帮哥哥贴补一些家用。
樊如星微皱起眉，不太希望她出门。「若柳，要不要我陪你一起去，最近那个薛少岗又来缠着你不放，你最好还是不要一个人出去。」
薛少岗是他们县令的小侄子，人看起来斯文，却是个纨子弟，偶然间见到樊若柳，便对她吃痴迷不已，他仗着有县令伯父当靠山，不顾她已有婚约在身，不时来搔扰她，想将她占为己有。
樊若柳淡淡一笑。「哥，你别这么紧张兮兮的，我只是出去上个香，一下子就回来，不一定会碰到他的。」
「凡事小心一点总没错，我在想，你要不要赶紧嫁给承知，只要你一成亲，薛少岗那个家伙就不能拿你怎样了。」

她轻蹙着眉说：「我……还不想那么早成亲。」
她和表哥根本没有任何情感可言，就只是单纯的表兄妹而已，她真的很不愿嫁给表哥，况且表哥似乎也对她没什么意思，要不然两家就不会直到现在都没动静，肯定是表哥也不乐意这门亲事。
「你不想这么早成亲？你都已经十八，早就该嫁了……」
「哥，我先出门上香，等上香完回来，我们再谈。」她笑笑地赶紧提着篮子出门去了。不想再听哥哥的叨念，更不想他跟来，反正她是绝对不会嫁给表哥的，如果表哥也没有这个意思，或许他们俩可以商量一下，解除这桩婚约，别再让这婚约束缚彼此。
樊若柳一个人走在热闹的大街上，往城南的方向走去，浑然不知从她一出门就有人暗地里跟在她背后，等待最好时机靠近她。
她一无所觉地拐进小巷子里，打算走捷径到观音庙，没想到这么做却让他们逮到机会，在没有其他人看到的情况之下，一把捂住她的嘴，将挣扎不休的她给硬是拖上马车，顺利地将她给带走了。
马车里，她被绑住双手，嘴巴被人用布巾塞住，还有两个男人监视着她，她惊慌害怕地瞪着他们，不知道自己会被带到什么地方去，更不知道为什么这些人要抓她。
过没多久马车就进入一间大宅第，之后便停了下来，两个男人紧接着将她给拉下车，逼迫她走上阁楼二楼，最后将她给推入阁楼的一间房间里，便识相地离开了。
「唔！」她因为强大的推力而狼狈的跌倒在地，有好一会儿无法起身，就在这时，让她感到十分厌恶的熟悉男人嗓音突然在房里响起，这才惊觉这间房原来还有其他人存在。
「若柳，你可终于来到我身边了，我等这一天不知道已经等多久了。」
是薛少岗！恐惧瞬间攫住她的心神。
薛少岗笑着来到樊若柳身边，他蹲下身，好心地拿掉她嘴里的布巾，解开她手上的绳子，一脸非常怜惜她的模样。「啧啧啧，那些人也真是太粗鲁了，居然这样对待你，等会儿我必须好好的训斥他们一顿才行。」
他摸着她柔嫩的手，发现她的左手腕上有一个小巧可爱的弯月胎记，他正想抚摸那胎记，但樊若柳猛力地收回手，不让他再继续轻薄下去。
樊若柳心惊胆战地瞪着他，警戒地看着他的一举一动，就怕他会做出什么伤害她的事情。「薛少岗，你要人把我绑到这里来，到底是想要干什么？」
「想要干什么？当然是想要好好的疼惜你呀！」他对她露出了痴迷的笑容。「以后这间阁楼就是属于你的房间，你只要待在这里好好的服侍我，我绝对不会亏待你的。」
「你作梦！」她用尽所有力气伸手推倒他，紧接着便爬起身挣扎着逃离房间。
薛少岗没想到她会突然来这一招，所以被狠狠地推倒在地。
「你这个该死的女人！」他气愤地站起身来，绝不让她离开。
「啊——」樊若柳才刚跑出房门，就被追出来的薛少岗死抓住手臂不放，她拚了命地挣扎着，死都不想成为他的女人，她一定要想办法逃出去。「你放开我，再不放开，我就要叫救命了！」
「你叫呀！」他表情变得狰狞可怕，他要的东西就一定要到手，谁都别想阻挠。「反正不会有人来救你的，你如果乖一点，我会待你温柔一点，你要是再继续不听话，就别怪我下手不留情了。」

「你这个该死的禽兽，别用你的脏手碰我！」
「你住嘴——」他狠狠地用另一只手甩了她一巴掌，那强大的挥打力量让她一瞬间往后倒，原本被他紧抓住的衣袖，也因为强力的拉扯而被撕裂开来，她整个人便从楼梯上摔了下去。
薛少岗一脸惊愕，没想到好不容易将她给带回来，却出现这种意外，完全让人始料未及。
「啊——」在昏厥过去前，她想着自己会死在这里吗？
不，她还不想死，她想好好地活着回去呀！
第9章(1)
戚无秋不眠不休地照顾草儿，虽然他身上也有伤，也有些疲累，但没亲眼见到草儿清醒，他就无法真正安心下来，所以不管其他人如何劝他，还是执意要亲自照顾她。
戚家其他的兄弟都拿他没辙，只好让他亲自照顾草儿，然后留一名丫鬟在一旁帮忙，如果有什么突发状况发生，也好赶紧通知他们。
content_en:
The doctor who was called hastily entered the guest room and began to examine and treat Cao'er's injuries. Qi Wuqiu was also taken aside to sit and rest, but he still refused to leave the guest room and insisted on staying with Cao'er.
When Qi Wuyong saw his bloody hands, he said in shock: "Third brother, your hands are all injured, please deal with them quickly."
"I'm fine, it's just a minor injury..." He didn't have any thoughts about himself now. He just wanted Cao'er to escape smoothly.
Qi Wuyong shouted with concern: "Even if it's just a small injury, it needs to be treated! Quick, someone, hurry up and get a basin of clean water and wound medicine, and treat the injury on the third brother's hand..."
Qi Wuqiu's heart was now focused on the unconscious Cao'er, and he allowed the servants to clean, apply medicine, and bandage his hands. He no longer felt any pain from the hand injury.
After the doctor finished treating Cao'er's injuries, Qi Wuqiu rushed to the bed again and asked worriedly: "Doctor, how is her condition?"
"Her left arm was fractured due to a strong impact, and the back of her head was scratched when she hit a sharp stone. Fortunately, she was rescued early. If it had been delayed for a while, the situation would have been critical."
"So what you're saying is that she's going to be fine?"
The doctor nodded. "Her arm will take a long time to recover and needs to be taken care of carefully. As for the injury on the back of the head, it is not very serious. Fortunately, it did not hurt any vital parts. She should be able to wake up in a while. As long as she can wake up, it will not be a serious problem."
After hearing the doctor's answer, Qi Wuqiu's fear of Gao Xuan could finally be relieved. He breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, it was not too late. Cao'er's life was finally saved by him, and he no longer had to worry about losing her forever.
When she wakes up, he promises never to let her leave again...
She was struggling in the darkness in a daze, her head throbbing with pain, and familiar scenes kept appearing in her mind, forcing her to face them.
She saw... a familiar room, and a man who made her feel friendly. That man seemed... to be her brother.
"Ruoliu, are you going out?"
"Yes, I'm going to the Guanyin Temple in the south of the city to burn incense and pray for everything to go well." She responded softly.
Her brother's business has not been going well recently, so she wanted to help him pray for good luck. In addition, she also hopes that some of the handkerchiefs and sachets she embroidered can be sold in stores to earn some money and help her brother supplement the family income.
Fan Ruxing frowned slightly, not wanting her to go out. "Ruoliu, do you want me to go with you? That Xue Shaogang has been pestering you recently. It's best for you not to go out alone."
Xue Shaogang was the nephew of their county magistrate. He looked gentle, but he was a playboy. When he saw Fan Ruoliu by chance, he became obsessed with her. He relied on the county magistrate's uncle as his backer, and ignored that she was already engaged. He harassed her from time to time and wanted to take her as his own.
Fan Ruoliu smiled faintly. "Brother, don't be so nervous. I'm just going out to have some incense and I'll be back soon. I may not run into him."
"It's always good to be careful in everything. I'm wondering if you should marry Chengzhi quickly. As soon as you get married, that guy Xue Shaogang can't do anything to you."
She frowned lightly and said, "I... don't want to get married so early."
She and her cousin had no feelings at all, they were just cousins. She really didn't want to marry her cousin, and he didn't seem to have any interest in her. Otherwise, the two families would have been silent until now. The cousin must not be happy with this marriage either.
"You don't want to get married so early? You are already eighteen, you should have gotten married long ago..."
"Brother, I'm going out to burn incense first. We'll talk when I come back after burning incense." She smiled and hurriedly carried the basket and went out. I don’t want to listen to my brother’s nagging anymore, and she didn’t want him to follow her. Anyway, she would never marry her cousin. If her cousin didn’t have this intention, maybe they could discuss and terminate the engagement and stop letting it bind each other.
Fan Ruoliu walked alone on the busy street, heading towards the south of the city. She had no idea that someone was secretly following her from the moment she left the house, waiting for the best opportunity to get close to her.
She turned into a small alley without realizing it, intending to take a shortcut to the Guanyin Temple. Unexpectedly, they got the opportunity to do so. Without anyone else seeing it, they covered her mouth, dragged her struggling into the carriage, and took her away smoothly.
In the carriage, her hands were tied, her mouth was gagged with a cloth, and two men were watching her. She stared at them in panic and fear, not knowing where she would be taken, let alone why these people wanted to arrest her.
Not long after, the carriage entered a large mansion and then stopped. Two men immediately pulled her out of the car, forced her to go up to the second floor of the attic, and finally pushed her into a room in the attic, and left knowingly.
"Hmm!" She fell to the ground in embarrassment due to the strong push, and was unable to get up for a while. At this moment, a familiar man's voice that made her feel very disgusted suddenly sounded in the room, and she was shocked to realize that there was someone else in the room.
"Ruoliu, you have finally come to me. I have been waiting for this day for I don't know how long."
It's Xue Shaogang! Fear instantly seized her mind.
Xue Shaogang came to Fan Ruoliu with a smile. He knelt down, kindly removed the cloth from her mouth, and untied the rope from her hand, with a look of great pity on her. "Tsk, tsk, tsk, those people are really rude for treating you like this. I have to give them a good scolding later."
He touched her tender hand and found a small and cute crescent birthmark on her left wrist. He was about to touch the birthmark, but Fan Ruoliu withdrew his hand violently to prevent him from continuing to be frivolous.
Fan Ruoliu stared at him in fear, watching his every move warily, fearing that he would do something to hurt her. "Xue Shaogang, you asked someone to tie me here. What do you want to do?"
"What do you want to do? Of course I want to take good care of you!" He smiled obsessively at her. "From now on, this attic is your room. As long as you stay here and serve me well, I will never treat you badly."
"You're dreaming!" She used all her strength to push him down, then got up and struggled to escape from the room.
Xue Shaogang didn't expect that she would suddenly make this move, so he was pushed to the ground hard.
"You damn woman!" He stood up angrily and refused to let her leave.
"Ah -" Fan Ruoliu had just ran out of the room when Xue Shaogang, who was chasing him out, grabbed her arm and refused to let go. She struggled desperately, not wanting to become his woman, she must find a way to escape. "Let me go. If you don't, I'm going to call for help!"
"You scream!" His expression became ferocious and terrifying. He must get what he wants, and no one can stop him. "Anyway, no one will come to save you. If you behave better, I will treat you more gently. If you continue to be disobedient, don't blame me for being ruthless."
"You damn beast, don't touch me with your dirty hands!"
"Shut up -" He slapped her hard with his other hand. The powerful force of the slap caused her to fall backwards for a moment. The sleeve that he had grasped was torn apart due to the strong pull, and she fell down the stairs.
Xue Shaogang had a look of astonishment on his face. He didn't expect that after finally bringing her back, this kind of accident happened, which was completely unexpected.
"Ah——" Before she fainted, she wondered if she would die here.?
No, she doesn’t want to die yet, she wants to go back alive and well!
Chapter 9(1)
Qi Wuqiu took care of Cao'er sleeplessly. Although he was injured and a little tired, he couldn't really feel at ease until he saw Cao'er awake with his own eyes, so no matter how others tried to persuade him, he still insisted on taking care of her personally.
The other brothers of the Qi family had nothing to do with him, so they had to let him take care of Cao'er personally, and leave a maid aside to help. If any emergency happened, they could be notified quickly.
